cache_policy.compilation_note: Inherited defaults may share compilation caches; no JIT isolation claimed.
cache_policy.tactics: private per arm/trial; cold and warm share only that cache

cache_policy.compilation_note: Inherited defaults may share compilation caches; no JIT isolation claimed.
cache_policy.tactics: private per arm/trial; cold and warm share only that cache

limits: 3 trial pairs provide descriptive evidence only; no significance or full-model serving claim.
Natural FILE-loaded warm lookup and forced-memory oracle lookup have different dispatch paths; oracle regret is diagnostic, not exact warm-path optimality.
Ordinal identities are shape-specific; -1 may execute the same underlying algorithm as an explicit ordinal.
M144 in this batch tunes and serves M144; it is not a cross-shape transfer test.
Compilation caches may be shared; warmup budgets do not establish clock stability.
Image metadata accompanies the runs; worker payloads do not independently attest the container digest.

method.aggregation: within-worker sample median, then descriptive distribution across trial medians; no pooled inference
method.oracle: forced-memory-cache public-API diagnostic; selected-to-best is a latency ratio, diagnostic regret is that ratio minus one, all within the same worker
method.oracle_rank: ascending within-worker wall medians; exact ties share competition rank
method.profiling: actual max-profile input M; warm selection interpretation uses its cold pair
method.ratios: paired within shape, trial and phase; numerator latency divided by denominator latency
method.unit: one fresh process per arm/phase/trial; cold/warm are paired by trial
